title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten library and campus study environments with documented noise designations, room rules, or after-hours access details.

cards.entity_name: Gitenstein Library Third-Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.title: Third-Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.subtitle: R. Barbara Gitenstein Library, Level 3
cards.notes: Set up in the non-central portion of Level 3 when silent open seating suits your work; keep collaboration for the designated rooms and central area.
cards.short_summary: A silent open-study zone on the library’s third floor.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ designates the third floor outside its central reading area and group study rooms as a Quiet Study Area, where open areas are silent.
cards.source_title: Noise Policy | R. Barbara Gitenstein Library
cards.access_notes: TCNJ ID or mobile credential is required after 6 PM on weekdays and for all weekend hours.

cards.entity_name: Gitenstein Library Fourth-Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.title: Fourth-Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.subtitle: R. Barbara Gitenstein Library, Level 4
cards.notes: Bring solo reading or writing to Level 4’s quiet open area; use one of the group rooms instead if your work needs conversation.
cards.short_summary: The library’s floor-wide quiet-study setting, apart from its group rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ designates the entire fourth floor of Gitenstein Library as a Quiet Study Area, with group study rooms treated as collaborative areas.
cards.source_title: Noise Policy | R. Barbara Gitenstein Library
cards.access_notes: TCNJ ID or mobile credential is required after 6 PM on weekdays and for all weekend hours.

cards.title: Third-Floor Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: R. Barbara Gitenstein Library, Level 3
cards.notes: Reserve a room for an individual session or a small-group project, and plan around the pilot’s daily and weekly reservation limits.
cards.short_summary: Nine reservable Level 3 rooms for individual or small-group academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Nine third-floor study rooms are available for reservation by individual TCNJ students or small groups under a pilot program.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Study Room (pilot) | R. Barbara Gitenstein Library
cards.access_notes: For TCNJ students; reservations may be made up to one week ahead, up to three hours daily and six hours weekly.

cards.title: Second-Floor Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: R. Barbara Gitenstein Library, Level 2
cards.notes: Use these rooms for collaborative academic work on a first-come basis; groups of two or more have preference, so arrive together.
cards.short_summary: First-come library rooms intended for collaborative schoolwork.
cards.evidence_claim: Study rooms on the second floor are first-come, first-served; TCNJ restricts their use to students, faculty, and staff and gives groups of two or more preference.
cards.source_title: Study Room Policy | R. Barbara Gitenstein Library
cards.access_notes: Not reservable; intended for academic work. A single user may be asked to move when a group needs the room.

cards.title: Fourth-Floor Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: R. Barbara Gitenstein Library, Level 4
cards.notes: Choose a fourth-floor room for a small project session, then reset the furniture neatly and leave the room clean when you finish.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative rooms embedded within the library’s quietest floor.
cards.evidence_claim: The fourth-floor group study rooms are Collaborative Learning Areas, while the rest of the floor is designated for quiet study; second- and fourth-floor rooms are first-come, first-served.
cards.source_title: Study Room Policy | R. Barbara Gitenstein Library
cards.access_notes: First-come, first-served for TCNJ students, faculty, and staff; groups of two or more have preference.

cards.title: Reference Room
cards.subtitle: R. Barbara Gitenstein Library, Level 1
cards.notes: Use the Reference Room when you need a collaborative setting close to library support; keep conversation muted and plan research questions in advance.
cards.short_summary: A Level 1 collaborative learning area near library services.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ identifies the Reference Room on the first floor as a Collaborative Learning Area, where muted conversation is permitted in open areas.
cards.source_title: Noise Policy | R. Barbara Gitenstein Library
cards.access_notes: Library Reference Services is located on Level 1; building access after 6 PM weekdays and on weekends requires TCNJ credentials or guest assistance.

cards.title: Lower Lobby
cards.subtitle: R. Barbara Gitenstein Library, Lower Level
cards.notes: Check whether an event or class is scheduled before settling in; when neither is using the lobby, it is designated for quiet study.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level space that becomes quiet study when not programmed.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ designates the Lower Lobby as Quiet Study when classes or events are not scheduled there.
cards.source_title: Noise Policy | R. Barbara Gitenstein Library
cards.access_notes: During final exams, the library sets up tables and chairs in the Lower Lobby for additional study space.

cards.title: Library Instruction Labs
cards.subtitle: R. Barbara Gitenstein Library, Lower Level
cards.notes: Use a lab for computer-based work when no class or event is scheduled; after closing, enter the Extended Study Area through the south door with ID.
cards.short_summary: Two lower-level labs available as part of the library’s after-hours study area.
cards.evidence_claim: Both Library Instruction Labs are part of Gitenstein Library’s Extended Study Area after the library closes, and are Quiet Study when no class or event is scheduled.
cards.source_title: Extended Study Area | R. Barbara Gitenstein Library
cards.access_notes: After library closing, access is through the south entry door and requires a valid TCNJ ID card.

cards.title: Arcade Room
cards.subtitle: R. Barbara Gitenstein Library, Main Level
cards.notes: Use this Level 1 option for collaborative coursework, especially if your schedule runs beyond normal library closing; bring your TCNJ ID for later entry.
cards.short_summary: A main-level collaborative area included in after-hours library access.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arcade Room on Gitenstein Library’s Main Level is included in the Extended Study Area after the library closes; the Extended Study Area is a Collaborative Learning Area.
cards.source_title: Extended Study Area | R. Barbara Gitenstein Library
cards.access_notes: After library closing, enter through the south entry door using a valid TCNJ ID card.

cards.entity_name: Brower Student Center Collaborative Study Spaces
cards.title: Brower Student Center Collaborative Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Clayton R. Brower Student Center
cards.notes: Use the student center’s collaborative study areas when your work benefits from an open lounge setting; check building operations before planning a group meet-up.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative study areas within TCNJ’s renovated student center.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ states that the renovated Brower Student Center includes collaborative study spaces, alongside lounges, meeting areas, and dining facilities.
cards.source_title: Brower Student Center History | Student Life
cards.access_notes: The source documents collaborative study spaces but does not specify individual room access or reservation rules.
